purpose: Audit whether the frozen full-reference boundary-rate machinery confuses source multiplicity with independent evidence when sources share a partition group. This is a development falsification audit, not a replacement scientific gate.

experiment.model: C independent identically distributed Bernoulli(theta) partition outcomes; all K distinct synthetic sources in a partition share its outcome exactly. Every source has one relevant condition, every condition is supported, and all assigned outcomes are observed.
experiment.estimand: theta is the independent-partition event probability. Equal K and perfectly shared outcomes make this also the equal-source event probability in this stress model only.
experiment.dependence_scope: Perfect within-partition dependence is a declared stress case, not measured audio dependence. Distinct synthetic source identities do not imply duplicate PCM or permission to split one real source.
experiment.coverage_reference: separate one-sided 95 percent bounds, not a simultaneous two-sided 95 percent interval
experiment.wilson: unchanged predecessor wilson_bounds with its frozen one-sided z and source count C*K or partition count C
experiment.exact: invert one-sided binomial tails at alpha=1/20 using exact integer/Fraction arithmetic; compare tail probabilities rather than numerically estimated interval endpoints
experiment.guard_scope: Grid decisions audit the boundary guard alone, not the combined bootstrap rule, other full-reference gates, or a human verdict.
experiment.false_claims: A safety guard pass is false only for theta>1/10; a sensitivity guard pass is false only for theta<4/5. At a gate boundary, interval noncoverage is still separately reported.
experiment.enumeration: enumerate k=0..C; mass choose(C,k)*theta^k*(1-theta)^(C-k); require exact mass sum 1; publish exact aggregate rational probabilities, no Monte Carlo standard errors
experiment.probability_numerics: coverage and guard-event probabilities are exact; legacy Wilson decisions retain the existing floating-point implementation. Exact boundary endpoint brackets use 64 rational bisections; display rounding is never a decision input.

fixture_boundary_check.base: unchanged predecessor synthetic_records, 80 cases / 40 source groups / 20 partition groups
fixture_boundary_check.transformation: replace only synthetic partition_group_id using deterministic source-index grouping; preserve all other record fields exactly and validate each variant with predecessor validate_records
fixture_boundary_check.execution: call unchanged _rate_summary on transparent and material subsets separately with 10000 bootstrap draws and fixed seed suffixes; compare rate bounds and source guards after excluding the diagnostic partition count
fixture_boundary_check.scope: only two synthetic boundary-rate components, never evaluate() or actual metric execution
fixture_boundary_check.requirement: report accepted/rejected variant state, group counts, point, bootstrap limits, Wilson guard limits, combined rate limit and numeric component pass; do not claim the whole full-reference evaluator passes

boundary_demonstration.observations: zero events for safety and all events for sensitivity
boundary_demonstration.checks: actual legacy source-group guard equals the corresponding wilson_bounds; publish exact partition-binomial endpoint brackets
boundary_demonstration.false_combined_component_claim_probabili: For each grid theta, publish probability of the all-zero/all-one event when that event passes the legacy combined rate component and the underlying population claim is false. Bootstrap extrema are exactly 0 or 1 for constant samples. This event probability is a lower bound on total false combined-component claims, not a full-gate probability.

weighting_counterexample.purpose: show equal-partition and equal-source event estimands differ under unequal cluster sizes; partition aggregation is not a drop-in repair

experiment.sampling_variance_identity: For 0<theta<1 and equal K shared outcomes, true variance of the source mean is theta*(1-theta)/C, versus the independent-source working variance theta*(1-theta)/(C*K), ratio K.

required_successor: Declare target population, sampling frame, independent unit, nesting or crossed dependencies, cluster-size weighting, and source-conditional versus population-average targets before collecting outcomes.
Do not infer independence from opaque IDs, group counts, or split isolation alone.
Address few independent groups and within-group correlation in uncertainty, support and resampling; increasing related source count is not increasing independent group count.
Any changed inferential gate needs a score-blind successor; this diagnostic must not rewrite frozen results or relabel consumed evidence.

references.title: Cameron and Miller (2015), A Practitioner's Guide to Cluster-Robust Inference
references.role: primary background on within-cluster dependence and independent-cluster assumptions, not a guarantee for this audit or a method selection

references.title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook, Confidence intervals
references.role: Wilson formula and exact binomial tail inversion
